title: Специальные вопросы
description: Составь специальный вопрос: выбери вопросительное слово и вспомогательный глагол

items.statement: My dad drives to work by car.
items.answer: How does your dad drive to work?

items.statement: My family travels to the sea by train every summer.
items.hint: Как часто твоя семья ездит на море?
items.answer: How often does your family travel to the sea by train?

items.statement: We go to school by bus.
items.answer: How do you go to school?

items.statement: My mum goes to work at 8 o'clock.
items.hint: Во сколько мама ходит на работу?
items.answer: What time does your mum go to work?

items.statement: My brother rides his bike in the park.
items.answer: Where does your brother ride his bike?

items.statement: My parents visit our grandparents every Sunday.
items.hint: Как часто родители навещают бабушку с дедушкой?
items.answer: How often do your parents visit your grandparents?

items.statement: Our family has dinner together at seven o'clock.
items.answer: What time does your family have dinner together?

items.statement: My cousin lives in a big city.
My friends walk to the sports centre after school.
items.answer: Where do your friends walk after school?

items.statement: My sister takes a taxi to the city centre.
items.hint: Как часто сестра ездит на такси в центр?
items.answer: How often does your sister take a taxi to the city centre?

items.statement: My dad uses the underground in the morning.
items.answer: When does your dad use the underground?

items.statement: We go to the country by car in August.
items.hint: Когда вы едете за город на машине?
items.answer: When do you go to the country by car?

items.statement: My mum and dad work in the city centre.
items.answer: Where do your mum and dad work?

items.statement: My friend goes to school on foot.
items.answer: How does your friend go to school?

items.statement: Our family visits the museum on Saturday.
items.answer: When does your family visit the museum?
